extracted.intended_audience: writers crafting short stories (fiction authors, especially early-career or practicing writers)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical tips for composing short fiction that maximizes impact within a limited length — advice on form, structure, mood, character count, theme, title, and revision. Focused on making each short story succeed by concentrating on a few key elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experiment with form
rubrics_metrics.description: Experiment With Form — Recipes, text messages, real estate ads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use unconventional formats (e.g., recipe format, text-message exchanges, faux real-estate listings) to shape voice, structure, or reveal plot/character. The examples suggest leveraging form as a storytelling device rather than defaulting to standard prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Start with a strong hook
rubrics_metrics.description: Start With a Strong Hook — Each line important, especially the first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the opening line compelling; in short fiction every line must earn its place because of limited space. Prioritize clarity, intrigue, or emotional grab in the first sentence/paragraph to pull readers in immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify inciting incident and climax
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the Inciting Incident and Climax — Two key plot points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly locate the story's inciting incident (what sets events in motion) and its climax (the turning or decisive moment). Structure the short story around these two points to maintain narrative focus and momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evoke a specific mood
rubrics_metrics.description: Evoke a Specific Mood — Funny, creepy, nostalgic, or heartbreaking; let mood inform decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose one clear mood/tone and let it guide choices in language, detail, and plot. A tightly maintained mood helps a short story feel complete and unified despite its brevity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep the timeline short
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep the Timeline Short — Begin closer to the climax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit the story's temporal scope: start the narrative near the events that lead directly to the climax rather than covering a long chronology. This preserves focus and heightens urgency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimize the cast of characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimize the Cast of Characters — Two characters or even one protagonist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restrict the number of characters (often two or even a single protagonist) so each gets sufficient development in limited space. Avoid introducing extraneous characters who distract from the central conflict or theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose a specific theme
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose a Specific Theme — "Short stories are too small to explore every nuance."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pick one focused theme or idea to explore; accept that a short story can't cover every nuance. Let that central theme shape plot choices, imagery, and character arcs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on a 'knockout' element
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on "Knockout" — "The short story wins by knockout"; excel at one central element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim to excel spectacularly at one primary element (voice, twist, emotional punch, image, etc.) so the story delivers a strong, memorable impact rather than being merely competent in many areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Give your story an interesting title
rubrics_metrics.description: Give Your Story an Interesting Title — Hooks readers; "the real first line."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a title that intrigues or sets tone because it often functions as the reader's first impression. Treat the title as an active part of the storytelling, not an afterthought.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit thoroughly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revise repeatedly to tighten language, clarify meaning, eliminate dead weight, and ensure every line contributes. Intensive editing is essential for short fiction to achieve maximum effect in minimal space.
